title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 10 JULY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 09 July 2026 A few showers will occur in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the Central hills, North-central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Puttalam, Hambantota, Trincomalee and Mannar districts.
